info.title: API.SH: Zocdoc
info.description: The Zocdoc API from API.SH: public Zocdoc data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Open appointment slots of a Zocdoc doctor at each office (and video visits), as the booking calendar shows them: per office the address, phone and video flag, the next available time, the slot count and the start times day by day, for 1-14 days from `start_date` (default today). Slots depend on the visit reason (default: the doctor's usual one; ids in the profile's `visit_reasons`), new or existing patient, insurance plan and time of day. An unknown id answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zocdoc-availability

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Doctor id (the number at the end of a profile URL, e.g. 7363), its `provider_id`, or the profile URL itself (https://www.zocdoc.com/doctor/... or /dentist/...).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days to cover, 1-14 (default 7).

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD, default today).

parameters.name: visit_reason
parameters.description: Visit reason id from the doctor's `visit_reasons` (default: the doctor's usual reason).

parameters.name: new_patient
parameters.description: true (default) for new-patient slots, false for existing patients.

parameters.name: insurance_plan
parameters.description: Insurance plan id from /zocdoc/v1/insurance?carrier=<id>.

parameters.name: time_of_day
parameters.description: Only slots before 10am, after 5pm or both.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Everything a Zocdoc profile publishes about a doctor, dentist or other provider: name, title, credentials, gender, photo, NPI, specialties, professional statement, languages, hospital affiliations, board certifications, memberships, awards, education and training, state licenses where listed, age groups seen, focus areas and therapy approaches (mental health), payment notes and self-pay prices, new-patient and video-visit flags, overall / bedside-manner / wait-time ratings, review count with the count per star, recommend and short-wait percentages, the review summary and keywords, practices, every office (address, phone, fax, coordinates, office hours, in-network / out-of-network / self-pay) with its open appointment slots for the next `days` days, the next available time, accepted insurance carriers with their plans, popular and all visit reasons (ids for /zocdoc/v1/availability), and the most relevant reviews (`reviews`, up to 50; reviewers as the site shows them: first name and last initial, or empty). An unknown id answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zocdoc-doctor

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Doctor id (the number at the end of a profile URL, e.g. 7363), its `provider_id`, or the profile URL itself (https://www.zocdoc.com/doctor/... or /dentist/...).

parameters.name: reviews
parameters.description: Reviews to include, 0-50 (default 10, most relevant first; /zocdoc/v1/reviews pages through all).

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days of open appointment slots per office, 0-7 (default 3; 0 leaves them out).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Insurance carriers Zocdoc matches providers against, by type (health, dental, vision): id, name and default plan id. With `carrier`, that carrier's plans (id and name). The ids are the `insurance_carrier` and `insurance_plan` filters of /zocdoc/v1/search and /zocdoc/v1/availability. `q` filters by name. An unknown carrier answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zocdoc-insurance

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Carrier type (default health).

parameters.name: carrier
parameters.description: Carrier id: answer its plans.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only names containing this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Zocdoc practice (clinic, dental office, group): name, statement, photo, websites, total review count, specialties, every location (address, phone, fax, coordinates, office hours, video-visit flag), its doctors (id for /zocdoc/v1/doctor, name, credentials, specialty, rating, review count, the locations they work at), accepted insurance carriers with their plans, and the latest reviews across its doctors (`reviews`, up to 50, with the doctor each one is for). Pass the practice id (the number at the end of its URL) or the URL. An unknown id answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zocdoc-practice

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Practice id (the number at the end of a practice URL, e.g. 30816), its `practice_id`, or the practice URL.

parameters.name: reviews
parameters.description: Latest reviews to include, 0-50 (default 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Verified patient reviews of a Zocdoc doctor: review id, date, overall, bedside-manner and wait-time ratings, comment, reviewer (first name and last initial as the site shows it, or empty), video-visit flag and helpful count, plus the doctor's rating, review count and count per star. Sort newest (default), oldest, highest, lowest or the site's relevance, and filter to one star rating. 1-100 reviews a page (default 50); pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page. The first 500 reviews in each order are reachable (page x limit up to 500); use the sort orders and the rating filter to reach others.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zocdoc-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Doctor id (the number at the end of a profile URL, e.g. 7363), its `provider_id`, or the profile URL itself (https://www.zocdoc.com/doctor/... or /dentist/...).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this overall rating (1-5).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-100 (default 50).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (page x limit up to 500).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Doctors, dentists and other providers on Zocdoc (US) for a specialty near a place, in the site's own order or by distance, availability or wait-time rating. Filters: insurance carrier and plan (only providers who take it), visit reason, gender, spoken language, in-person or video visits, new or existing patient, time of day. Each result: doctor id (for /zocdoc/v1/doctor), name, title and credentials, profile link, photo, specialty and specialties, overall, bedside-manner and wait-time ratings, review count, recommend and short-wait percentages, a review snippet, new-patient and children-only flags, in-network / out-of-network / self-pay, self-pay prices where listed, badges, distance in miles, the office (address, phone, coordinates, video-visit flag), the practice, and the open appointment slots for the next `days` days with the next available time. `total` is the number of matches. 1-50 results a page (default 20); pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page. A place the site cannot find answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zocdoc-search

parameters.name: specialty
parameters.description: Specialty name (dentist, primary care doctor, dermatologist, optometrist...) or id from /zocdoc/v1/specialties. Umbrella names such as Eye Doctor return few or no results; use the specific specialty (Optometrist, Ophthalmologist).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: US city, address or ZIP code. Required unless lat and lng are given.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude (with lng, instead of location).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude (with lat).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: default (the site's), distance, availability (soonest bookable first), wait_time (wait-time rating).

parameters.name: insurance_carrier
parameters.description: Insurance carrier id from /zocdoc/v1/insurance.

parameters.name: insurance_plan
parameters.description: Insurance plan id from /zocdoc/v1/insurance?carrier=<id>: only providers in network for it; `accepts_insurance` says per result.

parameters.name: visit_reason
parameters.description: Visit reason id from /zocdoc/v1/specialties?specialty=<specialty> (e.g. 11 dental cleaning).

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Provider gender.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Spoken language(s), comma-separated, e.g. Spanish.

parameters.name: visit_type
parameters.description: any (default), in_person or video.

parameters.name: new_patient
parameters.description: true (default) for new-patient appointment slots, false for existing patients.

parameters.name: time_of_day
parameters.description: Appointment slots only before 10am, after 5pm or both.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days of open appointment slots per result, 0-7 (default 3; 0 leaves availability out).

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: First day of the slots (YYYY-MM-DD, default today).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-50 (default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every specialty Zocdoc lists (id and name, for /zocdoc/v1/search), optionally filtered by `q`. With `specialty`, that specialty's visit reasons instead (ids for the `visit_reason` filter).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zocdoc-specialties

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only names containing this text.

parameters.name: specialty
parameters.description: Specialty name or id: answer its visit reasons.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
